label: DEMO DATA - synthetic evaluation set. Fictional people, accounts and handles. Not real customer data.
notes: Written on 2026-10-12 on branch hardening BEFORE any hardening fix was implemented, and frozen with a checksum before the detector was run on it. The author had read the rule regexes, the v2 holdout set and its errors, so v3 is less blind than v2: treat it as a fresh check of the fixes, not as an independent benchmark. Labels and acceptable outcomes were set from what a careful person should conclude, not from what the engine was expected to do. Domains use .example; UPI handles start with 'evalv3'. Not used to tune any rule.

outcomes.clear: risk level low and review_required false
outcomes.review: risk level low and review_required true

labels.scam: a fraud attempt; the positive class
labels.ambiguous: a reasonable analyst could not decide; scored only against its acceptable outcomes
